description: As casscf.json's cases, from the same starts (the exact RHF's orbitals and the same 'active' or AVAS pick), with PySCF mcscf.CASSCF(...).density_fit(auxbasis=...): every two-electron quantity of the CASSCF, the core's J and K included, over the fitted integrals, gated against mc2step and polished to |g| < 1e-10 as there. The fitting set is this tree's data/aux_basis file each case's 'aux_basis' names, handed to PySCF as parsed shells, not its library copy. Hartree; coordinates in bohr
